relevance_note: Case reports of two girls with molecularly confirmed arterial tortuosity syndrome: 'P1 was homozygous for the c.254T>C, p.(Leu85Pro) missense mutation and P2 was homozygous for the recurrent c.685C>T, p.(Arg229*) nonsense mutation'.
method_note: Hand-read; JSON assembled with a small Python script in scratch and every span checked verbatim by script. Six in-scope people: P1 and P2 (first-hand), plus four previously published individuals with individual-level facts in the text: the two Macedonian brothers of Ritelli et al. [3] (second cousins of P1; printed as '(patients 2 and 3)' in the earlier report, not used as labels here because they would clash with this paper's P1/P2 and the text does not tie each number to a specific brother), labelled 'ref [3] patient' (the 8-year-old, mentioned first) and 'ref [3] patient 2' (the 6-year-old); the 12-year-old Belgian boy (family A) of Callewaert et al. [6] ('ref [6] patient'); and the 8-month-old boy printed as '(Patient 1)' in Ritelli et al. [7] ('ref [7] patient', again to avoid clashing with this paper's P1). The brothers' features come from a sentence naming the pair ('The two Macedonian brothers ... presented with'), recorded as 'inferred from group statement'; their 'right ventricular dilatation or hypertrophy' is an either/or statement, so the ventricular hypertrophy checklist item is not reported for them. Variants for the referenced patients are printed only as 'the same mutation' / 'the same homozygous mutation of P2'; the c.685C>T string is taken from P2's description with both spans quoted. The second nonsense variant of ref [7] patient is not described, so its row has variant_original_string 'not reported'. Transcript NM_030777.3 (methods) was recorded only for P1 and P2, whose variants were annotated in this study. Pathogenicity 'pathogenetic variant' is the authors' wording for c.254T>C. For 'widespread arterial tortuosity' in referenced patients, 'tortuosity of arteries other than the aorta' was marked observed (widespread tortuosity is not limited to the aorta); aortic tortuosity left not reported. P1: 'Heart ultrasound was appropriate for sex and age (pulmonary pressure 20 mm Hg)' was recorded as pulmonary hypertension excluded (the pressure is named) and as 'abnormal heart ultrasound' excluded; it was not used to exclude ventricular hypertrophy. Normal height/weight recorded as short stature and low weight excluded. P2: age at diagnosis not stated explicitly (examined at 9 years, then molecular analysis), left not reported; age at death recorded as P9Y from surgery at 'the age of 9 years' and death on the second postoperative day. is_proband left null for everyone: the paper does not use 'proband' or 'index case' (P1 is marked by an arrow in the pedigree figure only). Minor inconsistencies: the case text prints 'p.(Leu85 Pro)' with a space while the abstract and Figure 3 legend print 'p.(Leu85Pro)'; the Discussion says P2's surgery 'involved stent insertions and patching' whereas the case report describes a tube graft of a decellularized patch with no stent mentioned (treatment summary follows the case report). Study type recorded as 'case report' (section 'Case reports'), though two unrelated patients are described.
